description: A type alias does not survive the catalog: INT/INTEGER/BIGINT/SMALLINT/TINYINT/BYTEINT are NUMBER(38,0), DECIMAL/NUMERIC keep their parameters as NUMBER, STRING/TEXT/CHAR/CHARACTER/NVARCHAR are VARCHAR, DOUBLE/REAL are FLOAT, DATETIME is TIMESTAMP_NTZ, and DESCRIBE agrees with the result column alias for alias. The result-column surface is read through a CTAS-over-the-column + DESCRIBE proxy (the CTAS inherits the resolved catalog type, so a catalog that kept the alias would fail these pins). Converted 1:1 from ddl/TypeAliasNormalisationTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE ia (a INT, b INTEGER, c BIGINT, d SMALLINT, e TINYINT, f BYTEINT)
CREATE TABLE ia_probe AS SELECT * FROM ia
CREATE TABLE dn (a DECIMAL(10,2), b NUMERIC(10,2), c NUMBER(10,2))
CREATE TABLE dn_probe AS SELECT * FROM dn
CREATE TABLE ca (a STRING, b TEXT, c VARCHAR(5), d CHAR(3), e CHARACTER(3), f NVARCHAR(4))
CREATE TABLE ca_probe AS SELECT * FROM ca
CREATE TABLE fl (a DOUBLE, b REAL, c FLOAT)
CREATE TABLE fl_probe AS SELECT * FROM fl
CREATE TABLE db_t (a DATETIME, b BOOLEAN)
CREATE TABLE db_probe AS SELECT * FROM db_t
CREATE TABLE da (a INT, b BIGINT, c DECIMAL(10,2), d CHAR(3), e STRING, f DOUBLE)
